text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels satisfying, but I should weigh each stock’s prospects rather than treat a realized gain as proof that selling was best.","My account value has fluctuated despite several profitable sales, so I should assess progress across the whole portfolio, not just each position’s gain or loss.","I rarely trade, and short-term ups and downs alone are not a reason to act; I can hold when the longer-term case for a position remains sound."]}
